For each image it can subtract background (COMET only), segment whole cells and optionally nuclei with Cellpose, Mesmer or CellSAM, measure shape and per-channel intensity for each cell, add KRONOS2 embeddings, and write a QC report. The cells and their measurements are written to a GeoJSON file that opens in QuPath. **Documentation: ** (also readable in [`docs/`](docs/README.md)). ```mermaid flowchart TD input["Multiplex TIFF"] --> extract["Extract markers"] extract --> bgsub["Background subtraction"] bgsub --> combine["Combine membrane channels"] input --> combine combine --> choose{"Segmentation method"} choose -- Cellpose --> convert["sopa convert"] convert --> patchify["sopa patchify"] patchify --> cellpose["Cellpose on each patch"] cellpose --> resolve["sopa resolve"] resolve --> totiff["Parquet to TIFF"] totiff --> smooth["Smooth masks"] choose -- Mesmer --> mesmer["Mesmer"] mesmer --> smooth choose -- CellSAM --> cellsam["CellSAM"] cellsam --> smooth smooth --> measure["Cell measurement"] measure --> geojson["GeoJSON"] measure --> kronos["KRONOS2 embeddings"] kronos --> kgeojson["GeoJSON with embeddings"] kronos --> markers["Marker report"] measure --> report["Segmentation report"] style extract stroke-dasharray: 5 5 style bgsub stroke-dasharray: 5 5 style smooth stroke-dasharray: 5 5 style kronos stroke-dasharray: 5 5 style report stroke-dasharray: 5 5 ``` Dashed boxes are optional steps. Nuclear segmentation is optional for every method and is off by default. ## Quick start Requirements: Nextflow 24.04.2 or later, and Apptainer, Singularity or Docker. Cellpose, CellSAM and KRONOS2 need a GPU. Test your setup from a clone of the repository (the test samplesheets use paths relative to the repository root): ```bash git clone https://github.com/WEHI-SODA-Hub/sp_segment.git cd sp_segment nextflow run . -profile test,singularity --outdir results ``` Write a samplesheet with one row per image: ```csv sample,run_backsub,run_cellpose,tiff,nuclear_channel,membrane_channels slide1,true,true,/data/slide1.ome.tiff,DAPI,CD45:Pan-Cytokeratin ``` Run the pipeline: ```bash nextflow run WEHI-SODA-Hub/sp_segment \ -r 0.5.0 \ -profile singularity \ --input samplesheet.csv \ --outdir results ``` Set parameters on the command line or with `-params-file`, not in a `-c` config file. Mesmer needs a DeepCell token: `nextflow secrets set DEEPCELL_ACCESS_TOKEN `. Next steps: - [Install and test](docs/getting-started.md) - [Running at WEHI](docs/wehi.md) (Milton and Seqera Platform) - [Samplesheet](docs/reference/samplesheet.md) and [parameters](docs/reference/parameters.md) - [Outputs](docs/output.md) - [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) ## Tools - [Background_subtraction](https://github.com/SchapiroLabor/Background_subtraction): COMET background subtraction - [Cellpose](https://www.cellpose.org) through [sopa](https://github.com/gustaveroussy/sopa): patch-based segmentation - [MesmerSegmentation](https://github.com/WEHI-SODA-Hub/mesmersegmentation): Mesmer segmentation - [CellSAM](https://github.com/vanvalenlab/cellSAM): foundation-model segmentation - [cellmeasurement-py](https://github.com/WEHI-SODA-Hub/cellmeasurement-py): nucleus-to-cell matching and measurements - [KRONOS2](https://huggingface.co/MahmoodLab/KRONOS2): per-cell embeddings - [spatialVis](https://github.com/WEHI-SODA-Hub/spatialVis): segmentation report plots ## Credits WEHI-SODA-Hub/sp_segment was originally written by the WEHI SODA Hub. We thank the following people for their extensive assistance in the development of this pipeline: - Michael McKay (@mikemcka) - Emma Watson ## Contributions and support See the [contributing guide](docs/developer/contributing.md).
